data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to launch external apps or URLs on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to open another app by package name or URL scheme, check if an app is installed, and open URLs in browsers or Safari. Handles platform-specific requirements like Android 11+ package visibility and iOS URL scheme whitelisting.
use_when: You need to open a third‑party app from your Flutter app
You want to check if a specific app is installed before launching
You need to open a URL in a specific browser or Safari
avoid_when: You only need to open web URLs (use url_launcher instead)
You need deep navigation within your own app
strengths: Supports iOS URL scheme whitelisting and Safari opening
Provides fallback to app stores if app not installed
weaknesses: Requires native manifest changes on Android
No support for deep linking into app content beyond URL scheme
data.setup_notes: Add <queries> block in AndroidManifest.xml for each target package; add LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in Info.plist for iOS URL schemes; no build_runner needed.
